info.title: Local CDC + Lua MVP
info.description: Implemented loopback-only single-user API, no authentication. Local JSONL/manifest only, not Iceberg/S3. 1 MiB JSON requests; duplicate/unknown keys rejected. Lifecycle commands are asynchronous; inspect instance state.
